name: kalshi-crypto-books
notes: Structural gates over one `orderbooks` capture of source kalshi-crypto: one book per OPEN market at one capture instant. The bid ladders are lists the rule engine cannot inspect; their shape is the pack's contract (tests drive it). Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-kalshi-crypto-books.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: No open crypto market at capture time is a broken capture, not a quiet one.
One book per market per capture instant.
